sources.label: App patches by Dudek, for use with Morphe.
sources.author: Dudek
patch_list: Restores version-specific Unity startup after re-signing.
Routes Google Play Games sign-in and player/server authorization through MicroG-RE 7.1.0+. Requires app.revanced.android.gms.
Replaces Coffee's blocking update/install notice with one short toast and continues loading the game.
Completes the requested rewarded-video flow locally using the game's callbacks.
